decision: built scripts/toolslist-snapshot.sh as the before/after lever for the token cut

decision: fixed demo-mode startup panic by building a real client around canned auth instead of a typed-nil client
why: typed nil passed the type assertion in Drafts() and every similar accessor; root cause not symptom
result: legacy-full demo registers 69 tools; lint and tests pass

decision: demo advertises full surface: OAuth-gated and browser-gated tools both register
why: demo exists to show the catalog; partial catalog made the lever lie
result: dnd and lists tools now appear in demo tools/list

decision: conversations_open upserts the opened DM into the channels snapshot instead of a background full ForceRefreshChannels

decision: keep both error styles; errorRecovery middleware already preserves ToolError code/retryable via errors.As, so only the Warn log noise was real; typed errors now log at Debug
why: audit claim 'agent loses code/retryable' is false: NewTypedErrorResult(err) runs on every Go error; rewriting 40 sites buys no agent-visible change

why: Slack Lists ignored SLACK_MCP_GOVSLACK; a single switch point cannot drift again

why: server binary now cross-compiles for windows; pkg/test/util (Setpgid/Kill) still unix-only but only integration tests import it

decision: unit-tests workflow: pull_request_target -> pull_request, make lint step added
why: pull_request_target runs fork PR code with repo secrets; lint was local-only
result: yaml edited; make lint passes locally

decision: build-dxt mkdir -p; make release pushes to RELEASE_REMOTE (default personal) and refuses unknown remotes; release workflows gated on github.repository == korotovsky/slack-mcp-server
why: origin is upstream so make release would tag upstream; fork tag pushes would trigger npm/ghcr publishes that must fail
result: make -n release TAG=v0 shows push to personal

decision: deleted dead boolean SLACK_MCP_*_TOOL gates; registration = slices.Contains(enabledTools); three channel allowlists remain; startup warns on leftover vars and falsy allowlist values; docs rewritten
why: main.go always resolves an enabled list so boolean gates never decided registration; one rule is explainable in one sentence
evidence: pkg/server/server.go addEnabledTool; cmd/slack-mcp-server/main.go warnRemovedGateVars; AGENTS.md Tool surface
result: legacy-full snapshot 69->68 tools, only usergroups_me removed; daily-power snapshot byte-identical; make lint + race tests green

decision: WithRecovery moved innermost; toolHandlerOptions extracted; panic and ToolError round-trip tests
why: panic previously became JSON-RPC -32603 which agents cannot retry on

decision: output schemas kept only for auth_status and the five prepare/execute tools; outputSchemaByTool map replaces per-tool WithOutputSchema
why: tools/list legacy-full 124,207 B -> 64,002 B (-48%), daily-power 38,011 B -> 14,702 B (-61%); agent only needs machine-parsed fields for approval_token and auth diagnostics

decision: renamed jsonschema_description tags to jsonschema (31 sites)
why: google/jsonschema-go reads only the jsonschema tag; every field doc incl. trust guard was dropped
evidence: pkg/handler/results.go usergroups.go channels.go channel_mutations.go; snapshot now shows field descriptions
result: field descriptions appear in auth_status schema

decision: detail description cut 436->~210 ch; channel_id and cursor descs are consts; 11 'Requires client confirmation' sentences removed (destructiveHint carries it)
why: boilerplate x N in tools/list; env var text unactionable for agent
result: snapshot sizes in T2 row include these

decision: auth_status text fallback compact JSON via fallbackJSON; other fallbackJSON sites left as-is
why: live Claude Code call showed structuredContent envelope, text is hidden there; other clients see compact JSON already
result: no behavior change for structured clients

decision: Claude Code renders structuredContent and hides text when both present (saved_list live call returned envelope JSON, not the CSV+legend)
why: tabular tools ship two representations and clients disagree which one the agent sees; CSV is ~2-3x cheaper than keyed JSON per row
evidence: live saved_list limit=2 via session gateway
result: Track 3 rule: tabular tools return CSV text only with #next_cursor/#partial comment lines; small mutation/status payloads stay structured JSON

decision: 118 blank parameter descriptions filled by delegate (adddesc.py lever + check.py over fresh tools/list snapshot); repeated sentences hoisted to descChannelIDRaw/descPrepareAction/descApprovalToken

decision: normalizeAnnotations at registration: readOnly => destructive=false, idempotent=true; additive writes (create/invite/schedule/upload/add_message/reactions_add/join/open/set_status) destructive=false; 14 dead per-tool annotation options on daily-power tools deleted (catalog overrode them)
why: snapshot showed destructiveHint=true on channels_list, history, search, users_search etc. via mcp-go defaults; clients that prompt on destructive would prompt on reads

decision: history/replies/search/get_message return CSV text only; cursor moves from last-row Cursor column to #next_cursor comment line; Channel column bare ID + #channels legend; get_message missing => message_not_found ToolError
why: one representation in every client; Cursor column cost a header+comma per row; three channel formats confused the legend

decision: channel_not_found/user_not_found/browser_session_required/message_not_found ToolErrors with the next tool named; seven copies of the browser gate collapsed into browserSessionRequired
why: raw fmt.Errorf gave the agent no remedy and no stable code

decision: three worktree delegates convert remaining tabular tools (A: unreads/activity/saved; B: channels/files_list; C: members/emoji/scheduled/drafts/semantic/usergroups/lists) against scratchpad/track3-spec.md + delegate-common.md

evidence: git ls-tree origin/master shows 8 npm files, 3 images, 3 compose files, manifest-dxt.json

why: fork-only directory, 33 merged plans, referenced by nothing outside itself; one docs location instead of three, no deletion

decision: pkg/transport gets tests: UA/cookie wrap, UA sniffing, uTLS HTTP/1.1 + HTTP/2 against httptest TLS, CONNECT proxy tunnel with basic auth, 407 and dial errors, ProvideHTTPClient env wiring (standard, custom TLS, proxy+CA, junk CA)
why: 345 lines of TLS/proxy code had zero tests; D5 named it
result: 14 tests; first run of the HTTP/2 test panicked

decision: Bump golang.org/x/net v0.55.0 to v0.58.0 (pulls x/crypto, x/sys, x/term, x/text)
why: Under Go 1.27 x/net v0.55 http2.Transport.NewClientConn dereferences a nil inner transport (newUserClientConn skips init); every SLACK_MCP_CUSTOM_TLS request that negotiated h2 would panic. v0.58.0 calls t.init() first. Targeted bump, not a general dep sweep
evidence: new test TestUTLSTransportHTTP2AgainstTLSServer: SIGSEGV at net/http.(*Transport).NewClientConn(0x0,...) before, HTTP/2.0 after; go test -skip=Integration ./... green
result: root cause fixed upstream; test pins it

decision: Split pkg/provider/api.go (1957 lines) into api/client/cachefile/refresh/channel_map/cache_channels/cache_users/browser_session/enterprise_merge/oauth_runtime; constructors newWithXOXP/newWithXOXC/validateAuthAndGetTeamID/NewMCPSlackClient collapsed into authTest+newMCPSlackClient+newProvider; usersRefreshCall/channelsRefreshCall and six begin/run/spawn methods replaced by one refreshFlight
why: One 2k-line file with two hand-rolled copies of the same refresh state machine; smallest-file-per-concern and one coordinator
evidence: worktree agent-a837825ae333eadb7; go test -race ./... green; provider diff 14 files +225/-1793

decision: transport.SlackDomain/SlackAPIBase replace provider slackAPIBase + edge getSlackBaseDomain; transport.RateLimited replaces four inline 429 parsers (people_channels, canvas, oauth, edge x2). Behavior: SLACK_MCP_GOVSLACK accepts any truthy value (was only the literal true); default Retry-After on unparsable 429 unified to 5s (was 0s in people_channels/canvas, 1m in oauth; oauth path still clamped to >=1m by managedOAuthRefreshInterval)
why: One-of-each; the truthiness widening matches every other SLACK_MCP_* boolean in the tree
result: accepted as deliberate; listed in Attention

decision: provider.New returns (*ApiProvider, error); all 9 provider and 5 transport logger.Fatal calls became returned errors; main.go fatal()s once with the wrapped error and defers p.Close()
why: A library package that exits the process is untestable and hides the real error behind the last log line
result: no Fatal/os.Exit left in pkg/provider or pkg/transport

decision: R1 ApiProvider owns ctx/cancel, Close(), lifetime(); background refresh and managed-OAuth loop derive from it. R2 waiters get the leader's error (or their own ctx.Err()), never nil. R3 cache file fsync before rename, json.Marshal compact, cache-dir fallback warned once. R4 ChannelsCache.add skips empty/@/# names. R5 searchUsersInCache sorts by ID then truncates. R6 one *http.Client per credential set on MCPSlackClient; lists/people_channels/canvas/managed-OAuth/browser attach reuse it. R7 startup jitter once in newMCPSlackClient; browser attach no longer jitters or double auth-tests
why: Each is a named audit finding; all fixed at the root rather than papered over
evidence: api_lifecycle_test.go: refreshFlight waiter error + ctx, deterministic search, Close stops refresh, managed OAuth loop stops on cancel, browserCall without session; 5x -race green

decision: R11 (warmup max+ctx) and R12 (SSE-key warn, auth triple-log) deferred: they live in cmd/slack-mcp-server/warmup.go and pkg/server/auth/sse_auth.go, outside the provider delegate's scope
why: Ownership boundary held; main thread handles after handler delegate lands
